title: Benowitz's drawings of an alien craft flown by the US government

tellings.quote: he said it was a a craft that the aliens had gave given to the United States government and the government was flying it and they didn't know how to do it and it crashed.

plain: Between 1980 and 1983, near Archuleta Mesa in New Mexico, aliens gave the US government a craft, the government flew it without knowing how, and it crashed, according to a man named Paul Bennewitz, who made drawings of it. The researcher Greg Bishop tells Michels what Bennewitz said, pointing to a document known as Project Beta. If true, the government would have been flying an alien craft it did not understand.
